mapper.select: SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name, u.nickname AS seller_nickname, u.phone AS seller_phone, u.avatar AS seller_avatar FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT p.*, c.name AS category_name FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM product WHERE title = #{title} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE status = #{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET view_count = COALESCE(view_count, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
